prompt: The client wants to know why its company-wide on-time delivery rate fell this year. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: The North stayed above 93% every month
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: The decline is concentrated in the South
options.feedback: Right. The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.

options.text: Both regions declined at the same rate
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: The North held at 94–96%; only the South fell.

options.text: The South's decline is due to a driver shortage
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: The decline is concentrated in the South. The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.

extras.proof: The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.
